item.title: Judge blocks additional citizenship provisions in latest setback to Trump's election executive order
item.description: A judge permanently blocked two provisions of the executive order that sought to impose proof-of-citizenship rules.

item.title: Coast Guard suspends search for people missing from fishing vessel that sank off Massachusetts
item.description: The U.S. Coast Guard has announced that the search for survivors on a commercial fishing vessel that sank off the coast of Massachusetts with seven aboard has been suspended.

item.title: Catherine O'Hara 'changed how so many of us understand comedy and humanity'
item.description: Catherine O'Hara was never afraid to go big. Known for roles in "Schitt's Creek," "Beetlejuice," and "Home Alone," she made her lines and characters memorable.

item.title: Moms with struggling adult children describe Reiner family tragedy as their 'worst nightmare'
item.description: In just more than a month, Nick Reiner will be back in court facing murder charges in the deaths of his parents, Rob and Michele Reiner. The circumstances of this case bring to light the plight of families with loved ones battling mental illness and addiction. We spoke with three mothers about the tragedy.

item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: Sunny and mild tomorrow; Coastal Flood Advisory, Beach Hazard Statement
item.description: February will begin on a mostly sunny and mild note tomorrow, much like today's weather, and we can expect even milder weather in the week ahead.

item.title: 'Sanford and Son' star Demond Wilson dies at 79 after battle with cancer, son says
item.description: The entertainment world is mourning the loss of 70's TV star Demond Wilson, who was most known for his role opposite Redd Foxx in the hit series, "Sanford and Son."

item.title: SF judge denies reducing felony charges for 80-year-old driver accused of killing a family of 4
item.description: A judge denied reducing charges from a felony to a misdemeanor for an 80-year-driver accused of killing a family of four after crashing into a bus stop in San Francisco's West Portal neighborhood in 2024.

item.title: SF Mayor Daniel Lurie vows 'safe experience' Super Bowl week as 1.3 million travelers expected
item.description: The countdown is on as the Bay Area gets ready to host the big game at Levi's Stadium in Santa Clara. San Francisco Mayor Daniel Lurie says the city is prepared to welcome football fans worldwide. The airport is expecting big travel numbers, forecasting at least 1.3 million travelers for the week.

item.title: Highway 99 in Central California reopens after 59-vehicle pileup, CHP says
item.description: At least 10 people were injured the pileup, which occurred amid heavy fog and low visibility about 40 miles north of Bakersfield.

item.title: Video captures chaos inside 59-vehicle pileup on Highway 99 in Central California
item.description: A woman and her mother were injured after becoming trapped in the massive 59-car pileup on Highway 99 early Saturday morning while traveling from Oxnard to the Central Valley.
